name: google-forms
description: Google Forms: read forms and responses, create forms, batch edits and publish settings behind opt-ins, Pub/Sub watches (OAuth or service account)

nodes.title: Get form
nodes.description: A form's title, description, settings, questions (items with questionId) and publish state; responderUri is the link respondents use

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create form
nodes.description: Create an empty form with a title (add questions with batch_update); it is created in the caller's Drive

document_title.description: File name in Drive (default: the title)

unpublished.description: true: create the form closed to responses (publish later with set_publish_settings); always true for agent tools

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Batch update form
nodes.description: Apply batchUpdate requests in order: updateFormInfo, updateSettings, createItem, updateItem, moveItem, deleteItem (as an agent tool only when GOOGLE_FORMS_TOOL_ALLOW_EDIT=1)

required_revision_id.description: Fail instead of editing if the form changed since this revisionId

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Publish or close form
nodes.description: Set whether the form is published and whether it accepts responses (accepting needs published) (as an agent tool only when GOOGLE_FORMS_TOOL_ALLOW_PUBLISH=1)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

filter.description: Only "timestamp > T" or "timestamp >= T" with T in RFC 3339 UTC, e.g. timestamp > 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z

nodes.title: Create watch
nodes.description: Publish form events (new responses or edits) to a Pub/Sub topic for 7 days; one watch per event type per project

topic_name.description: Existing Pub/Sub topic owned by the calling project, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/forms

event_type.description: RESPONSES: new submissions; SCHEMA: form edits

watch_id.description: Optional id (4-63 lowercase letters, digits, hyphens)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
